Before booking, check:

• Cut-off time
• Transit time

TEU stands for Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit.
In ocean freight, it is a standard measurement used to describe the capacity of shipping containers and ships.
•1 TEU = one standard 20-foot-long container
•2 TEU = one standard 40-foot-long container (FEU)
